validation_diagnostics.note: Perturbed examples have no human scores. Directional sensitivity probes do not establish accuracy.

interpretation.moe_vs_plain: MoE validation MAE is lower by 0.0151 (about 1.42%), but paired prompt-group interval includes zero. One seed only; no robust accuracy advantage established.
interpretation.latency: At 512 tokens, FP16 batch-one T4 request p50: plain 30.5717 ms, MoE 31.8185 ms. Small absolute overhead.
interpretation.transfer: Validation improved modestly for both heads. Selected transfer MoE test MAE 1.1289 is worse than the earlier IELTS-only MoE 1.1001; benefit not demonstrated on this holdout.
interpretation.diagnostics: Question swaps did not lower mean Task Response scores in 23 validation probes. Unlabeled perturbations indicate a relevance-sensitivity concern, not a scored benchmark.
interpretation.scope: Task 2 only. Task 1 data and training remain pending.
interpretation.release: Both complete checkpoints published publicly on Hugging Face, with verified matching weight hashes and standalone Transformers loaders. See reports/huggingface_transfer_published.json.
